selection.unavailable_or_unresolved: retain in denominator; do not label globally insufficient just because search failed
selection.review_order: source reference author blind to automatic retrieval outcomes; separate model-role reviewer after first annotations

baselines.typed: standard reported-aspect source index; precision-aware duplicates; typed cards and XML binding dependencies are available to all arms; no oracle concept or source ordinal
baselines.lexical: BM25 natural question over source text, source identifiers, and conventional typed concept words
baselines.structural: same ranking with whole tables, preceding headings, adjacent footnotes and internal one-hop links under same rendered budget
baselines.query_decomposition: fixed family-independent clause splitting and lexical variants; same source index and budget; no answer or gold-anchor access
baselines.oracle: full source/reviewed evidence diagnostic only, no competitive result

budgets.computational_cost: report indexing/runtime/source access separately; no claim that words equal LLM tokens or complete cost

source_reference.premises: source identity, values, units, periods, population/award/segment definition and claimed relation; exact source/span SHA256 and byte offsets
source_reference.multiple_valid_evidence: record observed alternative realizations; review retrieved alternatives before declaring a missing semantic premise
source_reference.truth_status: assistant-authored plus separate assistant review; not independent human gold
source_reference.no_inference: no causal conclusion from arithmetic coincidence; no cross-taxonomy equivalence by namespace stripping

primary_diagnostic: Full coverage of at least one reviewed witness set for every required claim, measured mechanically then checked for alternative supporting evidence. This is evidence retrieval, not QA accuracy.
task_admission: A source-supported natural question requiring a nontrivial relation/definition not supplied by typed filtering may justify task-matched reader preparation. A gap versus stronger automatic baselines additionally needs budget-matched missing-premise and alternative-evidence review. Oracle source access is not an automatic baseline score.
method_decision: No competitive win or novelty from one selected case. Record all24. At least two independently reviewed source-supported residual candidates across two histories are needed before expanding this particular task family; otherwise stop this probe and retain its negatives.
